zh-CN.title: 五台山
zh-CN.subtitle: 现实山地与佛教圣迹叙事的双重地点
zh-CN.shortSummary: 五台山同时具有现实山地、寺院网络和佛教圣迹叙事的层次，适合展示双层地理如何并存。
curatorialDescription: 现实地图只承载山地的真实地理指向；圣迹、感应和文殊信仰等内容进入神圣地理或传统叙事层。
地点条目不把后世朝圣网络直接倒推为隋唐时期的完整机构地图。
zh-CN.researchNote: 需要按寺院、碑刻、朝圣路线和不同历史时期补齐地点级来源与时间范围。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 隋唐佛教地理与后世圣迹叙事

value.zh-CN: 现实山地 + 神圣地理

en.title: Mount Wutai
en.subtitle: A real mountain and a site of Buddhist sacred narratives
en.shortSummary: Mount Wutai combines a real mountain landscape, monastic networks and Buddhist sacred narratives, making the museum's two-layer geography visible.
curatorialDescription: The real map carries only the mountain's geographic referent; relic narratives, visions and Manjusri devotion belong to the sacred or traditional layer.
The record does not project later pilgrimage networks backward into a complete Sui–Tang institutional map.
en.researchNote: Monasteries, inscriptions, pilgrimage routes and period-specific sources still need to be added at place level.
en.timeLabel: Sui–Tang Buddhist geography and later sacred narratives
